patch_description:
The current program is severely underfitting due to extreme parameter sharing (only 5 distinct params). The best prior had 10 distinct params and achieved 0.58 score with proper expressivity.

Changes:
1. Replace the over-constrained RY layer (only ry_a, ry_b) with more diverse parameters (ry_a through ry_d) to capture individual qubit rotations better
2. Replace fixed CZ gates with parametrized XX gates to add learnable entanglement
3. Add more diverse Ising interactions (mix of XX, YY, ZZ) with better qubit pair coverage
4. Add long-range diagonal couplings (ZZ on [0,4] and [2,6]) to improve connectivity between distant qubits
5. Reduce overall gate count while increasing parameter distinctness for better generalization

Target: ~11 distinct parameters, maintaining or reducing gate count while improving expressivity.
